sources.summary: Dezeen Showroom: Italian tile brand Casalgrande Padana has advertised a selection of its latest tiles on Dezeen Showroom, showing the varied and expressive potential of porcelain stoneware. Among the designs is the company's Saxum outdoor tiles, which, like the rest of the Saxum line, celebrate the beauty of natural stone. These tiles feature elegant veining The post Casalgrande Padana lists five of its tile designs on Dezeen Showroom appeared first on Dezeen .
